correctness.rationale: For y³=f=x⁴+a x²+b x+c over algebraic closure of F7, independently expanded f⁴ and f² in F7[x,a,b,c] and confirmed all five pinned Cartier matrix entries. The dx/y summand has scalar 2a, forcing a=0 for p-rank0. For a=0,b nonzero the 2x2 semilinear block is rank1 and its stable-rank-zero criterion M^(7)M=0 simplifies −c(2b^8+3c^6)=0. With t=c³/b⁴, this allows t=0,2,5; the quartic discriminant b⁴(4t−6) rules out t=5, and b=0 smooth case has nonzero stable rank. Both surviving curves have Cartier rank1/a-number2. Over algebraic closure scaling gives one marked class for each t; Bouw–Koutsianas–Sijsling–Wewers Lemmas 1.17 and 1.21 rule out hidden abstract isomorphism between the two nonspecial curves. The full parameter equivalence is symbolic; GF343 finite checks from package merely corroborate.
